systems.country_label: WAPIS; national Data Collection and Registration Centre (DACORE)
systems.platform: WAPIS, implemented by INTERPOL with ECOWAS
systems.owner: Funded by the European Union and implemented by INTERPOL; installed in each participating country's national DACORE
systems.tiers: launched in Benin, Mali and Niger by 21 September 2015; installed within a national centre, where existing paper police data are converted to digital and inserted with new police data from all national law enforcement agencies

systems.system: regional electronic police information sharing platform
systems.tiers: next phase of the programme as at September 2015

note: No fact: INTERPOL describes a system installed in one national centre that collects and centralises police information and converts paper data to digital, and does not say stations enter their reports or cases in it, which the typology requires before WAPIS is classed record.
